Post Date: 2019-03-01T10:10:30Z

Title: Should Select be optimized for MATERIALIZED VIEW?
Description: When using materialized view as a trigger, that said used for inserting data to table A when data is inserted to table B:

```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS tableBToTableA TO tableA
AS
SELECT
    some_fields
FROM tableB
GROUP BY some_fields
```

Is it also required to optimize the MV select so it uses partitioning key and sorting keys of `tableB`? Or it doesn't matter?
